what: When you hover a work photo card, a thick frame in each card’s own color (6% of the card width, inner corners rounded) covers it in .3s, and a label hidden at 200% below rises in .3s, .2s late, appearing in .5s. On release the label fades out first in .5s while dropping down, and the frame withdraws .1s later in .4s (all outQuad). On portrait cards (look: portrait) the label stands at the bottom left rotated -90° with only its opacity changing, and the frame is thicker at 9% of the card width

options.--fx-frame: Frame color (via style), default var(--kf-accent) — give each card a different ingredient color and each photo gets its own frame color like the original
options.width: Frame thickness = Card width × this share, default 0.06 (look: portrait 0.09)
options.--fx-radius: Frame inner corner radius (via style), default .8em
options.look: portrait: Vertical card — name tag stands at bottom left (3%·9%) at -90° and only fades in, no rising
options.in · out · lag: Frame enter and exit duration, label delay (sec) — default .3 · .4 · .2
options.rise: Distance the label rises (% of label height), default 200
options.[data-fx-part=frame]: (If absent, the part creates it) empty span for the frame slot
options.[data-fx-part=label]: (optional) label — a dot, a name and the like. Text color is up to the user (light, since it sits on a photo)

use: ● Work name
note: The card is supplied by the consuming side with position: relative, overflow: hidden and corners (the part sets only relative). On phones (no hover) it stays still — the original also hides the name tag below 991px

from.where: index.html .ms-card (staggered grid of main works — orange · green · maroon · blue frames, first card is vertical look: portrait · original Featured-hover-IN / OUT2)
